newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI UPS STAKE IN P.SANOMAT.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI UPS STAKE IN P.SANOMAT.

text.p: Finnish media group Amulehti-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had acquired a company, Plauttus Oy, and through the deal increased its stake in Pohjolan Sanomat Oy to 42.8 percent.

Aamulehti said Plauttus owned 42.5 percent of Pohjolan Sanomat's shares and controlled 26.4 percent of votes. After the acquisition, Aamulehti would, through its Alpress unit, control 26.9 percent of votes in Pohjolan Sanomat, it said.

Alpress also owns about 60 percent of Lapin Kansa, another newspaper in northern Finland, and Aamulehti said it was looking for increased cooperation between Pohjolan Sanomat and Lapin Kansa. Increased cooperation was the only way to keep publishing both newspapers seven days per week, Aamulehti said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
